# Writing implementation plans (Superpowers)

Converts a spec into a step-by-step implementation plan with small, testable tasks.

- Source: https://github.com/obra/superpowers
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/obra/superpowers/main/skills/writing-plans/SKILL.md
- Author: Jesse Vincent (obra)
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/writing-implementation-plans-superpowers-3a8e80fa

Used once requirements are known but before coding. Claude writes a plan document that lists the files to touch, breaks the work into right-sized tasks, and spells out each step, including the tests to write and commands to run. Plans are detailed enough for another agent or a junior developer to follow without guessing. Pairs with the subagent-driven-development and executing-plans skills.

**Try asking:**
- "Write an implementation plan for the spec in docs/payments.md"
- "Break this feature into tasks I can hand to subagents"
- "Plan the migration from REST to tRPC"

**Source:** [obra/superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers/tree/HEAD/skills/writing-plans) · MIT · by Jesse Vincent (obra)
